sources.verified_angle_summary: The Saudi Ministry of Interior (MOI) officially inaugurated its dedicated technology pavilion at LEAP 2026, themed "Technological Solutions for a Secure Nation." The launch, led by Assistant Minister of Interior for Technology Affairs Eng. Thamer bin Mohammed Al-Harbi, marks the Ministry's fifth consecutive participation in the global tech event. The pavilion showcases an array of advanced digital systems, focusing on field security, traffic safety, smart surveillance, and institutional e-services. It also highlights the Ministry's continuous efforts to leverage technology to enhance public safety and elevate the quality of digital services provided to citizens, residents, and visitors, including innovations linked to the Absher platform and digital identity solutions. This announcement represents a concrete operational deployment and exhibition of Saudi Arabia's digital government capabilities at LEAP 2026, distinct from generic event attendance.
